author: Ryan Daws
description:
Oracle has released JDK 27 into general availability, enabling default compact headers and quantum-ready TLS key exchange across enterprise Java environments. The production distribution delivers nine targeted Java Enhancement Proposals (JEPs), spanning runtime memory optimisations, compiler updates, and post-quantum network protections alongside dozens of low-level virtual machine fixes.
